pages.title: Your goal
pages.text: Build a spell that plays a sound, then cast it with a wand. You need only three assembly items.$(br2)Gather practice supplies from the ModularMagic creative tab. For survival practice, also carry a charged mana container; focus recovers naturally.

pages.title: 1. Gather supplies
pages.text: From the ModularMagic creative tab, take:$(li)Spell Writing Table$(li)Spell Core: Instant$(li)Spell Node: Self Pos$(li)Spell Node: Sound$(li)Beginner Wand$(li)Charged Basic Mana Container (survival)$(br2)Keep this guide in your hotbar for Ctrl lookup.

pages.title: 2. Insert the core
pages.text: Place and open the table. Put the Instant core in the top-right slot beside Take core.$(br2)The canvas shows a root with origin, action and optional casting-condition slots. Parameters and inventory are on the right.

pages.title: 3. Choose an origin
pages.text: Pick up Self Pos from your inventory and left-click the empty origin slot on the canvas.$(br2)One gem is inserted. This origin starts the spell at your feet and needs no parameters.

pages.title: 4. Add the action
pages.text: Insert Sound into the empty action slot. Leave the optional casting condition empty.$(br2)Your tree is now:$(li)Instant core$(li)Origin: Self Pos$(li)Action: Sound$(br2)Sound has no children.

pages.title: 5. Configure and check
pages.text: Select Sound. Set sound to minecraft:block.note_block.pling, volume to 1 and pitch to 1. Click Apply.$(br2)The status button beside the core should show success. Hover it to inspect any missing slots or invalid parameters.

pages.title: 6. Take your spell
pages.text: Empty your cursor and click Take core. Put the Formed Spell Core in your inventory and close the table.$(br2)It contains the entire tree. The root cannot be removed by right-clicking; only leaf nodes can be removed that way.

pages.title: 7. Load and cast
pages.text: Hold the Beginner Wand and sneak-right-click to open its nine core slots. Insert your formed core and close the screen.$(br2)Right-click to hear the note! In survival, this simple spell defaults to 11 mana and 5 focus. Switch cores with Up/Down, or the keys you selected in Key Binds.

pages.title: 8. Try a variation
pages.text: Return the core from the wand to the table. Change the sound pitch to 2, apply, extract and listen again.$(br2)You can also remove Sound and try another action. Start small before adding loops, selectors and entity effects.

pages.title: If something goes wrong
pages.text: Closing saves the core inside the table; reopen to continue.$(br2)An empty tree remains a typed core. A nonempty invalid tree becomes an Unformed Spell Core that you can edit again.$(br2)Next: $(l:modularmagic:editor)Controls$(/l) or $(l:modularmagic:nodes)Node Reference$(/l).
